exposure: cesarean section in first stage of labor
cesarean section in second stage of labor
cohort: 80 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section (30 in second stage, 50 in first stage) at Sri Devaraj URS Medical College, R.L. Jalappa Hospital and Research Centre, Tamaka, Kolar, Karnataka, India from May 2021 to May 2022.
finding: Cesarean section in the second stage of labor was associated with increased incidence of PPH, fetal distress, and NICU admission compared to cesarean section in the first stage of labor.
